name: xthing
description: XThing VPN — Desktop (Electron) & Mobile (Capacitor) client + backend

scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:client && npm run build:electron && npm --prefix electron run dist
scripts.make:win: npm run build:client && npm --prefix electron run make
scripts.package:win: npm run build:client && npm --prefix electron run package
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:client && npx cap sync android
